props.heading: How to apply for a bursary
props.intro: A bursary covers the full fee and travel for families on a low income. Most applications are answered within two weeks.

steps.title: Check you can apply
steps.text: Bursaries are for students aged 14 to 18 whose families get free school meals or a similar benefit.

steps.title: Write to us
steps.text: A few lines from the student about why they'd like to come. No essays, and no wrong answers.

steps.title: Have a short call
steps.text: One of the mentors rings to say hello and answer any questions you have.

steps.title: Get your place
steps.text: We confirm by email and send everything you need for the week, including travel tickets.
